title: 2022年6月四级真题 第1套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
passage:
P1 Online classes began to be popularized just a few decades ago. They are advertised as a way for adults to finish their education and students to learn the material at their own pace—it is far more compatible for people with busy schedules.

P2 But after being enrolled in an online course last fall semester, I came to realize online classes were merely a means to fulfil course requirements.

P3 First of all, students lack the desire to learn, and they simply complete their assignments to receive credit for a passing grade rather than genuinely engage with the course material.

P4 As online courses tend to have more than 100 students, most of the assignments are short and simple. They are not designed for students to interact with the material in depth but designed to be graded easily to accommodate such a large number of students.

P5 Perhaps the biggest disadvantage of taking an online class is the absence of face-to-face interaction between the teacher and their students. Live sessions are infrequent and are often scheduled during the middle of the day when students have to attend other classes or work. The office hours of the professor may also be during inconvenient times for many students as well. Most interaction with the professor has to be through email which is often impersonal. It is nearly impossible for students to build a relationship with their professor.

P6 There is also little interaction amongst students. It can be harder for students to create study groups and form relationships with their peers.

P7 Online classes also require either a computer or laptop and a reliable internet connection. Not all students have access to these types of resources, whether it is for financial or other reasons, and some students can be put at a disadvantage.

P8 Offering online classes certainly helps students who would otherwise not be able to attend classroom sessions. However, they fail to provide a genuine education with an emphasis on convenience rather than critical thinking. We need restructured online classes in which students can have a learning experience that will actually provide quality education.

questions.q: What does the author say about students enrolled in online classes?
options: They can access course materials easily.
They are unmotivated to learn.
They can learn at their own pace.
They rarely fulfil the course requirements.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say about students enrolled in online classes? 在问「就上网课 的学生这件事，作者具体说了什么」，是对单一陈述的事实核对。 46. What does the author say about students enrolled in online classes? A) They can access course materials easily. B) They are unmotivated to learn. C) They can learn at their own pace. D) They rarely fulfil the course requirements.

【拆句】题干主干是 What does the author say about X，标准的 say about 双宾结构，关于 X 的 对象是 students enrolled in online classes，其中 enrolled in online classes 是过去分 词短语作 students 的后置定语，等于 students who are enrolled in online classes，无 陷阱。

【定位】First of all, students lack the desire to learn, and they simply complete their assignments to receive credit for a passing grade rather than genuinely engage with the course material. 首先，学生缺乏学习的欲望，他们只是完成作业以拿到及格分数，而不是真正与课程内容打 交道。

【选项】A) 张冠李戴：宣传方观点≠作者观点 They can access course materials easily. 取自 P1 对网课的宣传性描述，并非作者本 人就「学生」给出的评价，问的是作者对学生说了什么，不是对网课说了什么。 B) ✓ 正确 lack the desire to learn ↔unmotivated to learn 预判要找「学生没有学习动力」的表达，四个选项里只有 They are unmotivated to learn. 直接对应 lack the desire to learn，故锁定。 C) 张冠李戴：照抄被驳斥的卖点 They can learn at their own pace. 原句正是 learn the material at their own pace 的 近乎照抄，是作者列为反驳对象的卖点，不是作者对学生的论断。 D) 与原文相反：rarely 类否定词反转事实 They rarely fulfil the course requirements. 说学生很少完成课程要求，但 they simply complete their assignments to receive credit for a passing grade 明示他们 恰恰会完成作业、只是为拿学分，方向相反。 作者如何看待在线课程作业? A) 它们被设计得便于批改。 B) 它们旨在促进互动。 C) 它们基于容易获取的材料。 D) 它们是为了适应学生的需求而布置的。

questions.q: What does the author think of online course assignments?
options: They are made convenient to mark.
They are meant to facilitate interaction.
They are based on easily accessible material.
They are given to accommodate students' needs.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author think of online course assignments? 指向作者对某一具体事物的 判断句，仍属细节核对。

【拆句】主干 What does the author think of X，think of 在此意为「认为…如何」，相当于 What is the author’s opinion of X，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。 47. What does the author think of online course assignments? A) They are made convenient to mark. B) They are meant to facilitate interaction. C) They are based on easily accessible material. D) They are given to accommodate students' needs.

【定位】They are not designed for students to interact with the material in depth but designed to be graded easily to accommodate such a large number of students. 这些作业的设计不是为了让学生深入与材料互动，而是为了便于打分，以应对如此庞大的学 生群体。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 designed to be graded easily ↔made convenient to mark 预判锁定「便于打分」的语义，仅 They are made convenient to mark. 直接对应；其 他选项要么扯到互动，要么扯到材料/学生需求，不在 designed to 的目的范围。 B) 与原文相反：not…but… 的前半句反着用 They are meant to facilitate interaction. 把作业说成「促进互动」，但 not designed for students to interact with the material in depth 明确否定了「互动」目的。 C) 无中生有：制造原文未提及的属性 They are based on easily accessible material. 说作业基于「容易获取的材料」，原文 P4 没有任何句子谈论材料的获取难易，凭空捏造。 D) 偷换概念：动词宾语被替换 They are given to accommodate students' needs. 把 accommodate 的对象从原文 to accommodate such a large number of students 中的「大量学生（人数）」偷换 成「学生的需求」，目的指向被改。 作者说在线课程的一个缺点是什么? A) 它们经常被安排在不规律的时间。 B) 它们使得教授的办公室难以接近得多。 C) 它们往往会增加教授回复学生邮件的负担。 D) 它们几乎不为学生提供相互建立关系的机会。

questions.q: What does the author say is one disadvantage of online classes?
options: They are frequently scheduled at irregular times.
They make professors' offices much less accessible.
They tend to increase professors' burden of responding to students' emails.
They provide little chance for students to build relationships with each other
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say is one disadvantage of online classes? 中 one disadvantage 是单数，明示只问其中一个具体缺点，是定点取信息的细节题。

【拆句】题干主干 What does the author say is one disadvantage of online classes，say 后是 省略 that 的宾语从句 (that) one disadvantage of online classes is what，what 提前 到句首形成疑问，需注意「what 在从句里实为表语」这一点，否则容易把 say 误读成不 及物。

【定位】There is also little interaction amongst students. It can be harder for students to create study groups and form relationships with their peers. 学生之间的互动也很少。要想组建学习小组、和同伴建立关系会更难。 48. What does the author say is one disadvantage of online classes? A) They are frequently scheduled at irregular times. B) They make professors' offices much less accessible. C) They tend to increase professors' burden of responding to students' emails. D) They provide little chance for students to build relationships with each other

【选项】A) 偷换概念 + 与原文相反 They are frequently scheduled at irregular times. 说直播课「频繁地」被安排在不规 律时间，原文 Live sessions are infrequent 恰恰说直播课很少，且原文谈的是「时间冲 突」而非「时间不规律」。 B) 偷换概念：时间不便 ≠ 空间不可达 They make professors' offices much less accessible. 把焦点放在「办公室更不可 达」，但 The office hours of the professor may also be during inconvenient times 只说「办公时间不便」，没有说办公室不可达，accessible 与 convenient times 不是 同义。 C) 无中生有：从一个事实派生未提及的后果 They tend to increase professors' burden of responding to students' emails. 谈 教授回邮件「负担加重」，原文 Most interaction with the professor has to be through email which is often impersonal 只说邮件互动「冷冰冰」，并未提教授 负担。 D) ✓ 正确 form relationships with their peers ↔students to build relationships with each other It can be harder for students to create study groups ↔provide little chance 预判核心是「学生 + 学生之间难建立关系」，They provide little chance for students to build relationships with each other 在主体、动作、方向上全部命中。 如果课程转到线上可能会出现什么问题? A) 更多学生可能会发现容易缺课。 B) 教师会担心网络连接不佳。 C) 一些学生参加课程可能会有困难。 D) 资源有限的学校将处于不利地位。

questions.q: What problem may arise if classes go online?
options: More students may find it easy to be absent from them.
Teachers will worry about poor internet connections.
Some students may have difficulty attending them.
Schools with limited resources will be at a disadvantage.
questions.explain:
【判型】What problem may arise if classes go online? 问「在网课条件下会出现什么问题」，问 的是文中已写明的某一具体后果，不需要推论。

【拆句】主干 What problem may arise，后接 if 条件状语从句 if classes go online，arise 为不及 物动词「出现」，结构清晰；注意 go online 这个搭配指「转为线上」，不要望文生义译作 「上网」。

【定位】Not all students have access to these types of resources, whether it is for financial or other reasons, and some students can be put at a disadvantage. 并非所有学生都能用上这些资源，无论是出于经济还是其他原因，有些学生因此可能处于不 利地位。 49. What problem may arise if classes go online? A) More students may find it easy to be absent from them. B) Teachers will worry about poor internet connections. C) Some students may have difficulty attending them. D) Schools with limited resources will be at a disadvantage.

【选项】A) 无中生有：把后果嫁接到主观行为 More students may find it easy to be absent from them. 谈学生「更容易缺席」， 原文从未谈学生主观逃课难易，凭空添加。 B) 张冠李戴：替换受影响主体 Teachers will worry about poor internet connections. 把网络问题的担忧者换成 teachers，原文 P7 通篇是 students 受影响，无任何关于教师担忧的描述。 C) ✓ 正确 Not all students have access to these types of resources ↔ Some students may have difficulty attending them some students can be put at a disadvantage ↔may have difficulty 预判核心「部分学生上不了网课」，选项 Some students may have difficulty attending them 主体、动作、可能性三要素与原文一一对位。 D) 张冠李戴：把人替换成机构 Schools with limited resources will be at a disadvantage. 把 at a disadvantage 的主体换成 schools，但 some students can be put at a disadvantage 明确主语 是 students。 作者认为什么构成了真正教育的关键部分? A) 获取有用的知识。 B) 在校园进行实际生活技能的训练。 C) 发展学生的个性。 D) 培养分析思维能力。

questions.q: What does the author think constitutes a key part of genuine education?
options: Acquisition of useful knowledge.
Training of real-life skills on campus.
Development of students' personalities.
Cultivation of analytical thinking ability.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author think constitutes a key part of genuine education? 仍是问作者 明示的具体内容，文末已直接点出，无需推断。

【拆句】题干主干 What does the author think X constitutes Y，think 后为宾语从句，从句里 What 同时是 constitutes 的主语，constitutes = 构成；该结构需要把 What 还原到从句 主语位才能读顺，是四级长难句的小考点。

【定位】However, they fail to provide a genuine education with an emphasis on convenience rather than critical thinking. 然而，网课未能提供真正的教育，因为它强调便利而非批判性思维。 50. What does the author think constitutes a key part of genuine education? A) Acquisition of useful knowledge. B) Training of real-life skills on campus. C) Development of students' personalities. D) Cultivation of analytical thinking ability.

【选项】A) 以偏概全：用常识替代作者主张 Acquisition of useful knowledge. 把「真教育」化约为「获取有用知识」，但 P8 强调 的是思维而非知识，且原文也未把「有用知识」列为真教育的关键。 B) 无中生有：用文章主题的相邻概念造干扰 Training of real-life skills on campus. 强调「校园里」「真实生活技能」两个限定，但 P8 既未谈 real-life skills 也未谈 on campus，是利用「网课—线下」对立常识捏造的 对立项。 C) 无中生有：搬用流行教育口号 Development of students' personalities. 把真教育的关键说成「学生人格的发展」， 原文 P8 通篇未涉及 personalities/character 之类的人格概念。 D) ✓ 正确 critical thinking ↔analytical thinking ability 预判核心是 critical thinking，四个选项里只有 Cultivation of analytical thinking ability. 直接对应 critical thinking 的同义改写，故锁定。
